about_the_game:
Qullusrent3 — A true puzzle challenge returns.

Move every block to its designated spot to clear the stage. The rules are simple, but the mechanics are anything but. Packed with clever gimmicks, each level demands deep thinking and trial-and-error. The moment you crack the solution is pure satisfaction.

The demo includes 12 stages, offering a gentle introduction to the controls and spatial logic. The full version features 120 stages of layered design and diverse mechanics, testing your reasoning, spatial awareness, and creative problem-solving.

Built with DirectX11 and MFC/Win32, Qullusrent3 delivers lightweight yet precise rendering. From shader-based camera-independent space design to effects driven by normals and depth, the game emphasizes physical plausibility and spatial consistency. Requires AVX2-compatible CPU and runs on Windows 10 x64 or later — optimized for both performance and precision.

Qullusrent3 supports 13 languages, including Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Korean, French, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Urdu, Burmese, and Khmer — allowing players worldwide to experience the beauty of logic and space beyond language barriers.

Simple rules, deep thinking. Qullusrent3 isn’t just about solving puzzles — it’s about enjoying the process of thinking itself.
